summary: Kamada Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to update shareholders on Israeli withholding tax procedures for its previously announced cash dividend of $0.17 per share (approximately $9.8 million total), payable September 17, 2026, to holders of record August 27, 2026. The company obtained a tax ruling from the Israel Tax Authority allowing eligible Nasdaq shareholders resident in treaty countries a reduced withholding rate, with IBI Trust Management appointed as processing agent. This is an administrative follow-up to the dividend announced August 17, 2026; no change in dividend terms. The event is a capital return via cash distribution; watch for shareholder documentation deadlines and actual payment execution.
